sources.researchNote: The upload title calls this a 1937 broadcast, but its description ends with “ALLAN JONES SINGS MY HEAVEN ON EARTH 1939 RADIO SHOW”, naming a different song and year. No programme documentation, exact broadcast date, label or matrix resolves this inconsistency; 1937 is retained only as an uncertain date of the described item. Jasmine Records’ official listing for Allan Jones: There’s a Song in the Air (JASCD110, released 10 January 1998) includes “Blue Venetian Waters” as track 8, independently documenting a Jones performance, but does not establish that this upload reproduces the same performance. The singer attribution for this particular transfer remains qualified.
